commands: kubectl get ns quant-staging 2>&1 || kubectl create ns quant-staging 2>&1

kubectl -n quant-staging get deployment quant-quantmail 2>/dev/null && kubectl -n quant-staging set image deployment/quant-quantmail quant-quantmail=$IMAGE 2>&1 || kubectl -n quant-staging create deployment quant-quantmail --image=$IMAGE --port=3010 2>&1
kubectl -n quant-staging expose deployment quant-quantmail --port=80 --target-port=3010 --type=ClusterIP 2>&1 || echo SERVICE_EXISTS
kubectl -n quant-staging rollout status deployment/quant-quantmail --timeout=180s 2>&1 || true
